description: This file defines the 'DIDRegistry' component responsible for managing Decentralized Identifier (DID) registries within the control plane. It includes functions for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and synchronizing registry data with a database, as well as searching for DIDs associated with specific components such as agents, reasoners, and skills.

classes.name: DIDRegistry
classes.description: Manages the storage, retrieval, and synchronization of DID registries, including in-memory caches and database persistence.

methods.name: NewDIDRegistryWithStorage
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DIDRegistry with specified storage provider.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Loads existing registries from the database into memory.

methods.name: GetRegistry
methods.description: Retrieves a DID registry for a specific server ID.

methods.name: StoreRegistry
methods.description: Stores a registry both in memory and in the database.

methods.name: DeleteRegistry
methods.description: Deletes a registry for a specific server ID from memory (database deletion to be implemented).

methods.name: UpdateAgentStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an agent within a registry and persists changes.

methods.name: FindDIDByComponent
methods.description: Finds a DID by component type and function name within a registry.

methods.name: GetAgentDIDs
methods.description: Retrieves all DIDs associated with a specific agent node.
